notes.title: Audio Trip: DANCE FULL OUT!
notes.content:
[h1]OUR BIGGEST AUDIO TRIP UPDATE IS HERE[/h1]
[h2][i]Goodbye, Early Access!![/i][/h2]

This isn't any ordinary update... When we say "major" we mean "MAJOR." Since our last update, (and really, the entire time we've been developing Audio Trip) the two of us have put every last ounce of energy and love into the game to make it what we always dreamed of it to be. This update is a HUGE milestone for us, culminating 5 years of conceiving, developing, and polishing Audio Trip to be the version of the game we knew it could be. This update includes a ton of new content and a pretty substantial polish of the look and feel of everything. The new features include a brand-new campaign mode, the introduction of game modifiers, achievements, a complete refresh of the leaderboards and scoring system, as well as NINE new songs for you to trip to! Read on for more details :winter2019coolyul:


[h2][i]NEW FEATURES...[/i][/h2]

[h3][b]>> Campaign mode[/b][/h3]
Decisions, decisions… We’ve updated our intro scene! Now when you launch Audio Trip, you get to decide whether you want to enter our brand new Dance Dojo to journey through the Campaign mode, or enter the Stadium to put your skills to the test in Freeplay mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35688153/9ca976e93bdf8f99f882251d333f54a50a94290a.gif[/img]

[h3][b]>> Modifiers[/b][/h3]
We wanted to bring you new ways to experience Audio Trip, so what better way to spice up your gameplay if not with good ol’ modifiers?

We've given you a few modifiers to start with, but to unlock them all, you must play through the Campaign challenges. ːsteamsunnyː Once you unlock each, it will then available in Freeplay to change up or add a little more challenge to the way you play. Is two-handed too easy for you? Try turning your hand gems invisible to see if you can still defend your title as the God of Accurate Hits! Bored? Why not try our one-handed modifier and test your endurance? Put together your set by choosing one or combining a few modifiers to find your desired difficulty level. And yes, many of them DO affect your score, so choose wisely!

notes.title: Cardio AND Playlists Mode OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Get ready for non-stop heart-pumping dancing![/h1]

First of all, if you haven't checked them out yet...

[h2][i]CARDIO LEVELS are now available on all 18 songs[/i][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35688153/c93caee3a81f318b7bf6bc57ace3cbe5f22a503c.gif[/img]
Based on the amazing feedback from our community, we just released the biggest content drop in the history of Audio Trip! Every single one of our songs now includes a new 'Cardio' level! Warm up those dancing muscles because these new levels are designed to make you sweat. Workout to a star-studded tracklist including artists such as [i]Lady Gaga[/i], [i]Skrillex[/i], [i]Zedd[/i], and more! :lunar2020hearteyesrabbit: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35688153/51e129109cd2ab73af8bf2b44b957e0747fccb1b.png[/img]AND this new Cardio level will be included in every new song we release from now on too!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35688153/c48686af2c4e8a92619fcb290d5c18f557ebc43f.png[/img][h3]>> A few words of caution << [/h3]
These choreographies are a bit different than the other three levels for each song. Cardio levels are designed with **BIG, full-range, single-beat, repetitious** movements to help you get into the groove easier and focus on your Cardio(vascular) health. That means you will have to pay a bit more attention to these points below when you play it for the first time:

[list][*] [b][i]FULL-RANGE PHYSICAL MOVEMENT REQUIRED[/i][/b] - Make sure to warm up before attempting these levels, use your knees to squat and lean under the barriers, and remember to move your feet to help you reach further out! If you experience any physical pain at any time, please take a break!
[*] [b][i]BIGGER PLAY SPACE REQUIRED[/i][/b] - Make sure to check that your play space is big enough for you to stretch out while playing and proceed with caution!
[*] [b][i]BEGINNERS BEWARE[/i][/b] - While nothing is stopping you from trying these levels if you just started Audio Trip, please note that it is designed to be around the Regular difficulty. Again, proceed with caution.[/list]
[i]Tip: Cardio levels for Dance Monkey & Golden Pineapple are less strenuous than others, so you could start with those![/i]



[i]But that's not all!!![/i] We now have a new Option for dancing trips continuously...
[h2][i]Playlists Mode[/i][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35688153/7d495af28627264c38bec3ed48384d14ddbecb1d.png[/img]

Under the Options menu, you'll now find a button for Playlists, which turns on this new mode. When in Playlists mode, you'll choose, edit, or create your own playlist and then launch to start your Trips! [i]And yes, you use the same launch button as always![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35688153/011c68f434d6629513dc1be988f034d2580a9d07.png[/img]

[h3]Built-in Playlists[/h3]
We've created some [b]Built-in Playlists[/b] for you to play - [i]which you can hide with the click of the 'Built-in Playlists' button if you like[/i] - but this mode is also for you to [b]create as many Playlists as you want![/b] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35688153/fe21511bc1adaa7f976ee99993656daa4e2a31fd.png[/img]

[h3]Create your own Playlists[/h3]
If you want to create a new Playlist, make sure you have Playlists Mode turned on (under Options) and just click the [b][ create new ][/b] button under the Playlists Menu. Then choose as many Trips as you want from the main menu to fill out your playlist! [i]And yes, this works with custom Trips as well![/i]

When you click on each Trip in the Main Menu, they will be automatically added to your new playlist.

[h3]Editing Playlists[/h3]
Once you create your new playlist, or choose one of ours to edit, there are few other things you can do:

1. [b]Switch each Trip length from Full Trip to Quick Trip[/b] right in the playlist using the Trip Type button next to each Trip.
2. [b]Remove Trips[/b] from the playlist.
3. [b]Rename[/b] the playlist.
4. [b]Save[/b] your playlist! [i]*Note: If you don't save, but play through the playlist, the game will automatically save a [b][ previously played ][/b] list for you - but just make sure to Save it if you'd like to keep it and play again![/i]

[h3]
Playing through Playlists[/h3]
Want to skip to the next song? Now when you Pause the game while Playlists mode is on, you'll see a new button to skip to the next song in the list. Of course you can also Restart the song, Resume where you left off, or Exit to the Hub World, like normal. [i]This option is available if you Fail during a Trip as well![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35688153/aac08d332f2161f214d66ee73b835de574dcf164.png[/img]

And as long as you DON'T have 'No Fail' turned on, [b]all of your scores in Playlists Mode will count toward the global leaderboards, just like any single Trip![/b]

Finally, if you'd like to return to just playing one Trip at a time, you can always just toggle off Playlists again under Options.


[h3][i]Have fun with your new playlists and all the Cardio levels![/i][/h3]
We'll get back to work now on more fun stuff to show you soon! Til then, [i]keep dancing.[/i]

notes.title: Update: Fresh Features for the Choreography Editor & Contest Reminder!
notes.content:
[h2]More tools to create custom songs![/h2]

Just a quick note about some new features and fixes for the Choreography Editor coming at you hot at the start of this fine week. These enhancements are coming just in time, too, as it's the final week to submit your custom choreography for the [b]Golden Pineapple Choreography Contest![/b] We hope the impact these new options have on your experience creating custom trips is as big and bold as your moves! ːsteamhappyː

-------------------------------
Now onto the good stuff...

[h2]Choreography Editor fixes and features![/h2][list]
[*] [b]NEW.[/b] [i][b]Mirror your moves![/b][/i] Save time by creating mirrored versions of sections to do the same move on the opposite side, along the x-axis. When you've copied a section you'd like, save it as a snippet, then just hit the new mirror button next to the snippets (see circled button in screenshot below) to create a mirrored snippet to use! (see adjacent new mirrored snippet)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35688153/6a5ba50d2dca37cf72a70f9c0b04f4dc18602916.png[/img]

[*] [b]NEW.[/b] [i][b]Drag elements forward and backward in time.[/b][/i] Grab any game element (Gems, DirGems, Ribbons, Drums, Walls) using the trigger, and drag using the grips at the same time to move the element (in real-time!) as you move through the song. 

[*] [b]NEW.[/b] [i][b]Pinch delete ribbons![/b][/i] You can now pinch delete the beginning and end of Ribbons to make them shorter! This is the same pinch delete you can use for any gameplay element, by holding the element (using the trigger) and clicking the joystick or trackpad (depending on your controller) to delete! [i]Note - if you pinch-delete the middle of a ribbon, the entire ribbon will be deleted.[/i]


[*] [b]FIX.[/b] Drum sentience has been dialed back, they should no longer move of their own accord. We fixed a strange bug that was erroneously moving the position of drums for some players. ːsteamsadː Please let us know if this persists for you![/list]

-------------------------------

notes.title: Update: First Time Players Help Us Find & Fix Hilarious Bug
notes.content:
[h2]Our heroes.[/h2]

A bug ONLY affecting first-time players has been fixed today, so thank you to everyone who tried our game and let us know their first trip may have seemed impossibly difficult! You are not bad - It was a bug that was causing players to experience Beginner and Regular choreographies at the same time on their first playthrough! ːsteamfacepalmː The intended mechanic was that players start at Beginner level and--with enough success and a high enough combo--the game would progress to Regular level. What you instead experienced, as mentioned above, were both difficulties simultaneously. No wonder some were having a hard time on their first tries! Thank you so much again for helping us find and splat this bug! ːsteamhappyː

We also took this opportunity to make some other improvements and fixes which you can find below! 

-------------------------------

[h2]<< New in version 1.0.1714 >>[/h2]

[h3]Major Fixes:[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed issue where players might encounter double gems, ribbons, etc on first play-through.
[*] Fixed issue where sometimes the 'You' leaderboard view was not showing where you were on the leaderboard. Now you can see exactly where you stand!
[/list]

[h3]Minor Fixes:[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an issue with the song timer display on the spectator camera. Now it correctly counts down after restarting a song.
[*] Fixed Undo / Redo in Choreographer Tool conflicting with pausing.
[/list]

[h3]Major Updates:[/h3]
We have enhanced the Choreography Tool with some added features and quality of life improvements!
[list][*] You can now use the grips on the controllers to push and pull backwards and forwards through your custom song in a measured, controlled, and intuitive way!
[*] Drums and Dirgems have a more natural starting position when placing them in your custom choreography. Of course you can then pull the handle on these to rotate them to your liking.
[*] Ribbon Explosion! We created a cool trick for those sweeping gem sections... If you create a ribbon on whatever beat division you choose, you can then choose the gem tool and click on the beginning of the ribbon, and voila! The ribbon will turn into gems along the same curve in that beat division!
[*] Pinch to delete! Try this for a quick erase of an object: While playback is paused, "grab" the item you want to delete ([i]hold down the trigger while hovering over the item with your cursor[/i]) and then while holding the trigger, click the center of the pad or joystick ([i]depending on your controller[/i]). Ta-dah! No need to open the console and switch to erase mode.
[/list]

[h3]Choreography Fix:[/h3]
[list][*] Removed impossible rogue ribbon on beat 78 in Satisfaction Expert. Thank you for finding this, Expert Trippers!
[/list]

[i]...and that's all the fixes for now! Enjoy![/i]
